name: reporter_cluster_new_types_handbook
description: Handbook test for new CardRenderTypes (BpsFormat, RankFormat, YearFormat, MonthFormat) and asset_spec transform. Verifies rendering of basis points, ordinal ranks, year/month formatting, and per-asset instrument metadata.
source:
# ========================================================================
# New CardRenderTypes + asset_spec Handbook
# Assets: SPY, QQQ, EURUSD | Timeframe: 1D
# ========================================================================

# === Market Data ===
src = study_assets()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l

# === Core Derived Series ===
daily_ret = (close - (close >> 1)) / (close >> 1)
ts = index()

# Date components
month_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.month, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year, timezone='America/New_York')(ts)

# === Asset Specification ===
spec = asset_spec()
tick = spec.min_tick
mult = spec.multiplier
asset_class = spec.asset_class
asset_name = spec.name

# === Pip/Tick Conversion (dynamic per-asset) ===
daily_move = close - (close >> 1)
move_in_ticks = daily_move / tick

# ========================================================================
# ASSET_SPEC: Pip/Tick conversion via min_tick
# ========================================================================

# T1: Per-asset tick stats in summary_table
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='00a asset_spec: Tick Stats',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Daily Move in Ticks',
      row_size=1, col_size=3,
      col_headers=['Mean', 'Max', 'Min'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
      ]))
(move_in_ticks, move_in_ticks, move_in_ticks)

# T2: Cross-sectional tick comparison — each asset uses its own min_tick
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    title='Avg Daily Move (ticks) + Asset Info',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Avg Ticks', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=1),
        ColumnSpec(title='Tick Size', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title='Multiplier', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='Asset Class', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat)
      ]),
    category='00b asset_spec: CS Tick Comparison')
(move_in_ticks, tick, mult, asset_class)

# T3: Asset name in cards
cards(
    category='00c asset_spec: Asset Info Cards',
    layout=CardLayout(
      title='Instrument Details',
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Name', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='Tick Size', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=4),
        ColumnSpec(title='Multiplier', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
      ]))
(asset_name, tick, mult, close)

# ========================================================================
# NEW TYPE 1: BpsFormat — auto-scales raw decimal × 10000
# ========================================================================

# L1: BpsFormat in summary_table — daily return as basis points
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='01 BpsFormat: Summary Table',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Return in Basis Points',
      row_size=1, col_size=3,
      col_headers=['Mean', 'Best', 'Worst'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.BpsFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max,
                   type=CardRenderType.BpsFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min,
                   type=CardRenderType.BpsFormat)
      ]))
(daily_ret, daily_ret, daily_ret)

# L2: BpsFormat in cs_summary_table — cross-sectional spread comparison
spread_vs_sma = (close - sma(close, 50)) / close
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Spread vs SMA50 (bps)',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Spread (bps)', type=CardRenderType.BpsFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
      ]),
    category='02 BpsFormat: CS Summary Table')
(spread_vs_sma, close)

# ========================================================================
# NEW TYPE 2: RankFormat — ordinal display (1st, 2nd, 3rd)
# ========================================================================

# Rank by cumulative return
cum_ret = agg(daily_ret, AggregationType.Sum)
ret_rank = cs_rank()(cum_ret)

# L3: RankFormat in cs_summary_table
cs_summary_table(
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    title='Asset Rankings',
    schema=TableReportSchema(
      columns=[
        ColumnSpec(title='Return Rank', type=CardRenderType.RankFormat),
        ColumnSpec(title='Cum Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(title='Close', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
      ]),
    category='03 RankFormat: CS Rankings')
(ret_rank, cum_ret, close)

# ========================================================================
# NEW TYPE 3: MonthFormat — month number to name (1→Jan)
# ========================================================================

# L4: MonthFormat in summary_table — first and last month in data
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='04 MonthFormat: Month Display',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Data Month Range',
      row_size=1, col_size=3,
      col_headers=['First Month', 'Last Month', 'Avg Return'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.First,
                   type=CardRenderType.MonthFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.MonthFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=3)
      ]))
(month_num, month_num, daily_ret)

# L5: MonthFormat in RowSpec GROUP BY — monthly stats with month names as headers
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.rowspec,
    category='05 MonthFormat: RowSpec Monthly',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Monthly Return Distribution',
      col_headers=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'],
      rows=[
        RowSpec(name='Mean', agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                type=CardRenderType.BpsFormat),
        RowSpec(name='Count', agg=AggregationType.Count,
                type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
      ]))
(daily_ret, month_num)

# ========================================================================
# NEW TYPE 4: YearFormat — year without commas (2020 not 2,020)
# ========================================================================

# L6: YearFormat in summary_table
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='06 YearFormat: Date Range',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Data Coverage',
      row_size=1, col_size=3,
      col_headers=['Start Year', 'End Year', 'Observations'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.First,
                   type=CardRenderType.YearFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.YearFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
      ]))
(year_num, year_num, close)

# ========================================================================
# MIXED: All new types in one table
# ========================================================================

# L7: Mixed new types in a comprehensive summary
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='07 Mixed: All New Types',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
      title='Comprehensive New Types',
      row_size=2, col_size=3,
      row_headers=['Return Stats', 'Time Info'],
      col_headers=['Value A', 'Value B', 'Value C'],
      cells=[
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.BpsFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean,
                   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.First,
                   type=CardRenderType.YearFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                   type=CardRenderType.YearFormat),
        ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count,
                   type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
      ]))
(daily_ret, daily_ret, close, year_num, year_num, close)
